tira_sub: Three poems of mine for small voices
seo_titulo: Vamos a cantar y a soñar: poems and songs for children
seo_desc: Anthology compiled by Nerys Pupo (Editorial de la Mujer, 2008) with three children's poems by Antonio López Sánchez: Náufrago, Tus ojos and Trovada.
cubierta_alt: Cover of Vamos a cantar y a soñar, illustrated by Juan Carlos García

ficha.título: Vamos a cantar y a soñar (Let's Sing and Dream)
ficha.autoría: Various authors, compiled by Nerys Pupo
ficha.incluye: The poems Tus ojos, Náufrago and Trovada de Grillo y Polimita, by Antonio López Sánchez

galeria.alt: A copy of Vamos a cantar y a soñar
galeria.pie: From the book Vamos a cantar y a soñar

catalogo.sinopsis: Texts, songs, games and poems for children, compiled by Nerys Pupo. Three poems by the author, one of which later gave birth to two characters of his children's books.
